<a id="music_command"></a>
### [`music_command`](../../../../src/music/commands.asm#L6) `$98CD`

*routine*

Does the command byte A of the music data. $c0-$cf set the note length. $f0-$f9 go through the handler table at $9f45.

- **Called from:** [`music_tick`](tick.md#music_tick)
- **Calls:** [`advance_data_offset`](note_time.md#advance_data_offset)

<a id="cmd_rest"></a>
### [`cmd_rest`](../../../../src/music/commands.asm#L44) `$990B`

*routine*

Command $f0: rest. Waits for one note length without a new gate.
Stops the read of the voice for this tick.

- **Entry of:** [`music_cmd_handlers`](../../tables.md#music_cmd_handlers)
- **Calls:** [`advance_data_offset`](note_time.md#advance_data_offset)

- **Refers to:** [`note_length`](../../memory-map.md#note_length), [`note_time`](../../memory-map.md#note_time)
